items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: He showed me how to play tunes, how to spell changes.

ctx.x: Well I knew the bass clef from the piano and I had the instruction in the book. I played. So I played all through high school. I represented my school in the All-City Band Orchestra. But in the meanwhile now, okay, so there’s a lot. That was one high school, by the way it was the same high school that Frank Foster went to, and there’s another guy Fred, a piano player. I can’t think of his name. They both went to that same high school. But anyway so in the tenth grade the teacher tells me — you wonder when did I…
let him play. He showed me how to play tunes, how to spell changes. So then the bug — it bit me.
That’s really interesting. And when you say he showed you how to play tunes, can you describe that a little more?
